variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders 'And with continual strife in his bones': 'strife' is riv (ketiv), reading we-riv atsamav ethan as 'the strife of his bones is continual'. The mapped textual_variant note, 'Another reading is, While all his bones are firm', is precisely the qere rov ('the multitude of his bones'), so the ASV places the qere in the margin and the ketiv in its text.
